name: Sampling-Based Optimizing Planners Benchmark for Outdoor Navigation
description: A comparative evaluation of sampling-based optimal planners for outdoor robot navigation measuring path quality, success rate, and computational cost across scenarios.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate along with path-quality metrics (path length, clearance/smoothness) and computational cost (runtime)
general_score_metric: success_rate (with path quality and runtime as key secondary metrics)
reputation: Well-regarded within motion-planning research for comparative evaluation of sampling-based planners, though adoption is mostly within planning/navigation specialists.
notes: Benchmarks are scenario- and environment-dependent; simulated vs real-world transfer can be limited. Results sensitive to implementation and parameter tuning; not an LLM benchmark.
